description: A large, fiery insect resembling a cockroach, the Emberroach thrives in ash-covered lands and volcanic regions. Its carapace smolders with ember-like heat, glowing faintly in the dark. This creature is drawn to destruction and fire, often igniting anything it touches. Known for swarming in numbers, Emberroaches are highly dangerous in groups, spreading wildfire wherever they go.

traits.name: Fiery Aura
traits.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of the Emberroach takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

traits.name: Swarm Instinct
traits.description: When within 30 feet of another Emberroach, this creature has advantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Ember Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Flame Burst
actions.description: The Emberroach can release a burst of flame in a 10-foot radius around itself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
